title: Petition for cleansing and light
english: Christ, Son of the most high God, remember your servant's heart—a sinner's heart—that has written these lines. Grant me release from the heart-bred passions growing in my impure soul. And grant me, Savior Jesus, to see your holy radiance, so that, appearing in that light, I may sing a healing song for souls and limbs to the great Father and the pure Holy Spirit.
